indicator.name: Crecimiento anual del PIB
indicator.description: Variación anual del PIB a precios constantes.
indicator.null_policy: No se interpola ni se convierte en cero.
indicator.methodology: La variación se expresa frente al año anterior sobre una serie a precios constantes; los cambios históricos se muestran en puntos porcentuales.

official_metadata.name: GDP growth (annual %)
official_metadata.source_note: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator denotes the percentage change over each previous year of the constant price (base year 2015) series in United States dollars.
